title: Dr. Jannini's lab report: death from pulmonary infection and septicemia

tellings.quote: Dranini issued a report stating that he died from a pulmonary infection that caused septasemia which is a generalized infection.

plain: A creature said to have been captured in Varginha, Brazil, in 1996, and which some say was an alien, is said to have died of a lung infection that spread through its whole body. A surgeon named Ahmed Foratu, who tells Michels he was a witness to the case, says a doctor named Jannini wrote a lab report stating that the creature 'died from a pulmonary infection that caused septicemia, which is a generalized infection.' If the report exists as he describes it, it would mean a doctor put a cause of death for the creature on paper.
